SAPAN KHETAN

📱 +91-9930999726 | ✉️ sapankhetan1990@gmail.com | 🌐 LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/sapan-khetan-002a56b2

Senior Data Scientist (AGM) | 12+ Years in AI/ML, NLP, MLOps, and Telecom Analytics

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Data Scientist with 12+ years of experience delivering AI/ML and application development solutions across telecom, manufacturing, and enterprise domains. Proven track record of deploying high-impact ML pipelines and cloud-native applications (AWS, Azure, Docker, MLflow) driving ₹100Cr+ in business impact. Expertise in Python (Flask, FastAPI, RESTful APIs), Generative AI, NLP, recommender systems, and database-driven applications. Experienced in leading and mentoring teams of 2–4 data scientists across Vodafone Idea, HCL, and TCS to deliver scalable, business-critical projects.

CORE SKILLS

Languages: Python (3.10+), SQL, Hive-SQL
Frameworks: Flask, FastAPI, Streamlit, Sanic (familiarity)
Python Libraries: Pandas, NumPy, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, XGBoost
MLOps & Deployment: MLflow, Airflow, Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Testing & Debugging, Documentation
Cloud Platforms: AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, ECS, DynamoDB, SQS, Bedrock), Azure ML
Databases: SQL (Postgres, HiveSQL)
Specialties: REST API development, NLP, Recommendation Engines, Churn Prediction, GenAI, Statistical Modelling
Other Tools: Linux, Hypothesis Testing, Feature Engineering, Agile/Scrum practices

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Vodafone Idea Ltd. — AGM, Senior Data Scientist

Feb 2023 – Present | Mumbai, India

Designed & deployed churn prediction and upgrade propensity models on AWS SageMaker, generating 8% incremental conversions (~₹15Cr annual impact).

Built automated retraining pipelines with performance monitoring, reducing model drift impact by 25%.

Conducted revenue impact analysis and GTM analysis for ML-driven campaigns; presented findings to CMO and marketing leadership.

Led data mining from Hive data lake, enabling faster campaign launches by 30%.

Implemented Agentic AI workflows using LangGraph on AWS Bedrock to assist calling agents with real-time customer insights and recommendations, improving agent efficiency and reducing average handling time by 20%.

Developed and optimized RESTful APIs (Flask/FastAPI) integrated with AWS services (S3, API Gateway, Lambda).

Led and mentored a team of 3 data scientists, driving delivery of multiple parallel business-critical AI/ML projects.

HCL Technologies — Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Sep 2021 – Jan 2023

Developed AutoML pipeline for manufacturing design optimization; reduced weekly retraining cycle by 30% using Airflow DAG orchestration.

Built scalable prediction APIs with FastAPI & Uvicorn; achieved <200ms latency for real-time inference.

Implemented MLflow model tracking & deployment, increasing reproducibility and reducing integration issues by 40%.

Containerized deployments using Docker (Windows images) for on-prem client environments.

Supervised a team of 2 data scientists, ensuring code quality, conducting peer reviews, and mentoring on ML best practices.

Interfaced with AWS ECS and DynamoDB for scalable deployment and data storage solutions.

Tata Consultancy Services — Machine Learning Engineer

Jul 2017 – Sep 2021

Delivered hybrid recommendation engine (Content + Collaborative) increasing content engagement by 25%.

Built NLP-based public meeting AI solution with 90% classification accuracy using GloVe embeddings & XGBoost.

Developed LSTM-based sentiment analysis achieving 85% accuracy & 83% F1 score.

Led transformer-based summarization POC for text summarization aligned to 'Attention Is All You Need' architecture.

Handled and guided a team of 4 data scientists, fostering skill development and ensuring timely delivery of client deliverables.

Worked with SQL (Postgres) and HiveSQL to design and optimize scalable data pipelines.

EARLIER EXPERIENCE

Tata Communications Transformation Services — Network Engineer, Quality Analyst, Team Member (Aug 2011 – Jul 2017)
Delivered production support for payment solutions (Power Card) and network activation services for Telstra (Australia). Led two Six Sigma Green Belt improvement projects, reducing operational errors by 20%.

EDUCATION

B.E. – Electronics & Telecommunication | Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Technology – University of Mumbai | 2007 – 2011 | 65%

Higher Secondary (Science – PCMB) | Thakur College of Science & Commerce – 2004 – 2006 | 90%

CERTIFICATIONS

AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt

TensorFlow Developer Certificate (if completed)

SELECTED PROJECTS

Price Elasticity Modelling for Prepaid Plans — Designed statistical model to predict customer sensitivity to price changes, aiding ₹50Cr+ pricing strategy.

Billing Defaulter Prediction — Achieved 96% accuracy using Chi-square tests, Pearson correlation, and k-modes clustering for feature selection.

Amazon Product Review Classification (Hackerearth) — Developed text classification model using deep learning for sentiment analysis.
